title: Bulk scheme-of-work generation
description: 'Make me 6 lessons on Romeo & Juliet for Y9 mixed ability' → outputs (a) MTP overview, (b) 6 paired worksheets + answer keys, (c) end-of-unit assessment, (d) knowledge organiser, (e) parent letter. All shareable as one ZIP, or pushed to LMS / Common Cartridge as a single unit. Moves Adaptly from per-lesson tool to per-unit tool — the unit teachers actually plan in.
rationale: User's improvement #6. The existing tools each output one artefact; the unit pack wires them into the planning cycle a department actually uses. Defensible because it's the lowest-friction way to fill an MTP slot in a SoW.
steps: Audit existing pieces: Lesson Planner (already shipped), MediumTermPlanner v2 (PR #43), Worksheet generator, knowledge organiser builder (mtp-v2-enhancements.ts deriveKnowledgeOrganiser), Parent Newsletter generator. Each is callable as a function — confirm and list call signatures.
Create client/src/lib/unitPack.ts:
- planUnit({ subject, yearGroup, topic, weeks, ability, board? }): UnitPlan
AI call producing the unit shape: { unitTitle; lessons: { week; title; objectives[]; specRefs[]; assessmentSlots? }[]; finalAssessmentSpec; knowledgeOrganiserOutline; parentLetterTopic }.
- executeUnit(plan, opts): AsyncGenerator<UnitProgress, UnitArtefacts>
Iterates lessons sequentially, calling aiGenerateWorksheet with the same brief used by Auto-from-class (PR-1) so each lesson aligns with the class.
After all lessons: one call for the end-of-unit assessment (uses the unit's specRefs + assessmentSpec); one call for the KO; one call for the parent letter.
Yields per-step progress so the UI can render a checklist.
- bundleUnit(artefacts, opts: { format: 'zip'|'cc'|'lms-push' }): Promise<Blob | { lmsUrl }>.
'zip' uses JSZip (already a dep, see existing exports), 'cc' delegates to PC3's commonCartridge exporter, 'lms-push' delegates to PC1's push.
Create client/src/components/UnitPackDialog.tsx:
- Single form: subject, year group, topic, weeks (slider 2–12), ability (mixed default), board (auto if previously set), output destination (zip / classroom / teams / .imscc).
- On Generate: live progress checklist (1/6 lesson plans, 2/6, ..., MTP, KO, parent letter, package). Abort button. Failed steps surface inline; the unit ships with whatever succeeded.
- After completion: download button + 'Open in /history' link.
Wire entry points:
- Add 'New unit pack' button on /tools/medium-term-planner top bar (consumes the existing MTP context for pre-fill).
- Add a row on /home next to WeekAheadPanel: 'This week's units → Plan a unit' link.
Tests:
- client/src/lib/__tests__/unitPack.test.ts — covers planUnit shape stability, executeUnit progress events, bundleUnit('zip') ZIP structure (extract + verify file names), abort mid-run.
Output cap: refuse to produce unit packs of > 20 lessons (token budget); show clear error.
do_not_touch: Individual generators (LessonPlanner, KO builder) — only consume them
Worksheets.tsx — UnitPackDialog opens worksheets via /history/:id when the teacher wants to view one
acceptance_criteria: UnitPackDialog can plan + execute a 6-lesson Y9 R&J unit in < 4 minutes wall clock on a typical setup.
Output ZIP contains: 1 MTP markdown, 6 worksheets PDF (pupil + teacher key), 1 end-of-unit assessment PDF, 1 KO A3 PDF, 1 parent letter PDF.
Aborting mid-run preserves whatever finished and surfaces partial download.
Pushing as a Common Cartridge produces a valid .imscc that imports into Canvas.
pnpm run check + pnpm run build + pnpm test --run pass.
verification: Manual: 6-lesson Y9 R&J + 4-lesson Y4 fractions; verify ZIPs.
context_budget_for_fresh_chat: MEDIUM. MTP + LessonPlanner are already split files; read narrowly only.
